MIDI IN

In Just play! every MIDI note plays normally with CC64 sustain, except C1, which toggles Keyboard Mode. In Explore CTL!, CTL octave 1 operates the GRAVITY controls; octaves 2–3 click the matrix (pedal up) or collect the chord (pedal down); octave 4 and above play only notes in the currently selected Parent Scale Candidate. Release the pedal to confirm a chord. The octave boundaries are adjustable below. MIDI OUT remains independent.

VIRTUAL MIDI KEYBOARD — TEST WITHOUT HARDWARE

Use the octave menu to test the zones. In Explore CTL!, first press Pedal down, then enter notes in CTL octaves 2–3, and finally press Pedal up to confirm. Individual notes in those octaves click the matrix if the pedal is up. CTL octave 1 runs shortcuts; octave 4 and above plays selected-candidate scale notes. In Just play! all notes sound except the mode-toggle C1. Click a key again to release it.

Default reference: CTL octave 3 = middle C (MIDI 60). Thus CTL octave 1 is MIDI 36–47, chord/matrix octaves 2–3 are MIDI 48–71, and scale-constrained octave 4 begins at MIDI 72. Lower pitches are unused in Explore CTL!; all pitches 0–127 (except the mode-toggle key) remain playable in Just play!. Octave 1 controls: C1 Mode, C#1 Lydian Tonic, D1 LC/Stack, Eb1 Focus Degree, E1 Keep Environment/Degree; F1=A, F#1=D, G1=S, Ab1=Tonic–Focus, A1=Q, B1=E, H1=W. Capture the physically pressed 2–3-octave notes while holding CC64 and apply on release. Duplicate octaves are consolidated, the lowest captured MIDI note determines the root, and the Focus position remains fixed. There is no MIDI THRU.

MEMBER SCALE SET

Russell's own 11 contains the eleven member scales worked out by George Russell. Extended 17 includes those eleven plus six additional useful member scales for further exploration. The six additional member scales are displayed with grey Italic fonts.
